# MODXFER live-acceptance fixture

`acceptance.modxfer.host_only` is an unpublished, test-only Lua mod used by the
local-UDP MODXFER gate. The host launches with this directory as its isolated
mods root; the joiner starts without the mod or a cached copy. Its magenta and
yellow banner provides an unambiguous actual-window effect on both peers after
direct transfer and exact stage reconstruction.

Do not add this fixture to the website directory.
